title: 14- Modern Oasis- The Music City Collection
description:
Large Home with open floor plan and private bedroom spaces.  

Beds: Four King Beds, Two Sleeper Sofas, look in the "about this space" section of this listing  for a layout description. 

Four Homes available at this location for Groups up to 32!

STRP#2026-07-01-751

The space
This is a three level townhome with rooftop deck.  The first level includes the attached garage, kitchen, dining, living room and powder bath. On the second level you have the primary bedroom with king bed and ensuite bath, the laundry room, and another bedroom with king bed and ensuite bath.  The third level includes the bonus room and rooftop patio with fireplace, as well as two additional bedrooms with king beds and a hall bath.  The living room sofa and sleeper sofa are fold down sleepers. 

Beds: Four King Beds, Two Fold Down Sleeper Sofas

Parking: Attached two car garage that can fit two small or mid-size vehicles.  One additional dedicated parking space is available behind the home. 

Getting Around:  We recommend ride share for exploring downtown as parking is limited and very expensive.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire private home and attached two car garage that can fit two small or mid-size vehicles.  One additional dedicated parking space is available behind the home. No Parking in the Shared Driveway.
